name: GhostFileUpload
description: Themed wrappers around headless GhostFileUpload, GhostFileUploadDropzone, GhostFileUploadTrigger, GhostFileUploadList, and GhostFileUploadItemRemove; GhostFileUploadItem and useGhostFileUpload are re-exported unchanged. Importing from @ghostvue/themes loads ghost-file-upload.css: token-based dropzone with idle, hover, dragging, invalid, and disabled states, a neutral trigger and quiet remove buttons with at least 44px targets and a visible focus ring, bordered list items, motion only when reduced motion is not requested, and forced-colors support. Rules key on data-themed, so headless parts stay unstyled.

props.name: accept
props.description: Native `accept` grammar: a picker hint that is also enforced on intake. Forwarded to headless GhostFileUpload.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled seed and form-reset baseline, captured once at setup. Forwarded to headless GhostFileUpload.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the trigger, drops, and remove buttons, and omits the mirror from submit. Forwarded to headless GhostFileUpload.

props.name: form
props.description: `form` attribute for the mirror and the picker. Forwarded to headless GhostFileUpload.

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the trigger (the labelable control), not of the root element. Forwarded to headless GhostFileUpload.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Consumer validity, combined with native constraint failure. Forwarded to headless GhostFileUpload.

props.name: maxFiles
props.description: Total list capacity. Floored; not finite or below 1 is unlimited. `1` turns `multiple` off. Forwarded to headless GhostFileUpload.

props.name: maxFileSize
props.description: Per-file limit in bytes; equal is accepted. Not finite or negative is unset. Forwarded to headless GhostFileUpload.

props.name: messages
props.description: Typed, reactive overrides of announcement and label text. Forwarded to headless GhostFileUpload.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Controlled list. `undefined` is uncontrolled; `[]` is a real empty value. Forwarded to headless GhostFileUpload.

props.name: name
props.description: Form mirror `name`. Without it no mirror renders and nothing is submitted. Forwarded to headless GhostFileUpload.

props.name: preventDocumentDrop
props.description: Cancel file drags and drops outside every dropzone while an enabled dropzone is mounted. Forwarded to headless GhostFileUpload.

props.name: required
props.description: Native `required` on the form mirror when `name` is set. Forwarded to headless GhostFileUpload.

props.name: validate
props.description: Synchronous, pure check after `accept` and `maxFileSize`; return a string to reject. Forwarded to headless GhostFileUpload.

models.description: v-model for the File[] list. Every change emits a new array with the same File instances; the consumer array is never mutated.

events.name: reject
events.description: Once per intake batch with at least one rejection, after update:modelValue. Fires even when a controlled parent ignores the list update.

slots.name: default

props.name: clear
props.description: Empties the list and `rejections`, and announces it.

props.name: clearRejections
props.description: Empties `rejections` without touching the list.

props.name: entries
props.description: Current list with stable ids for `v-for` keys.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Effective invalid state: `invalid` prop or native constraint failure.

props.name: openPicker
props.description: Opens the native picker. No-op when disabled.

props.name: rejections
props.description: Rejections from the most recent intake only.

props.name: remaining
props.description: `maxFiles` minus list length, never below 0; `undefined` when unlimited.

props.name: remove
props.description: Removes the first identical entry and applies the focus rule.

slots.description: Consumer layout of the parts, with the list entries, rejections from the latest intake, remaining capacity, effective invalid state, and actions.

exposed.name: openPicker
exposed.description: Opens the native picker; call inside a user gesture.

parts.name: root
parts.description: Grid stack of the consumer's parts with data-themed.

parts.name: dropzone
parts.description: Dashed surface; solid primary border while dragging.

parts.name: trigger
parts.description: Neutral action button, at least 44px, with a focus ring.

parts.name: list
parts.description: Unstyled-marker grid; styles its direct item children.

parts.name: item
parts.description: Bordered row (headless part, styled through the list's child combinator).

parts.name: item-remove
parts.description: Quiet button at the item's inline end, at least 44px, with a focus ring.

states.name: dragging
states.description: Dropzone while a file drag is over it.

states.name: invalid
states.description: Danger border with doubled width on the dropzone and trigger.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Disabled tokens on the trigger; reduced opacity on the dropzone.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-control-touch-min
cssProperties.description: Minimum block and inline size of the trigger and remove buttons.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-border-danger
cssProperties.description: Dropzone and trigger border when invalid.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-focus-ring-color
cssProperties.description: Focus ring on the trigger and remove buttons.

attributes.name: data-themed
attributes.description: Present on every wrapped file upload part.
